description: Diagnostic daemon that inspects smoke failure traces for registry_api.py, rug_pull_monitor.py, and signal_analyser.py. All three show identical importlib tracebacks suggesting a shared dependency import path issue. Reads sys.modules and __file__ paths to identify which dependency is causing the chain failure. Output is a structured JSON report to logs/ directory only — no DB writes, no integration. This is a diagnostic tool, not a fixer per DO NOT GENERATE rules.
